facts.fact: 西兰花与鼻屎的区别：小孩不爱吃西兰花——即小孩都爱吃鼻屎，答案把提问引到错误方向
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between broccoli and bogies? Children don’t like eating broccoli.

facts.fact: 棕色的、听起来像钟声的是什么？DUNG（粪）——与 DING 只差一个元音，先给声音再给实物
facts.anchor: What’s brown and sounds like a bell? DUNG!

facts.fact: 棕色、黏的是什么？一根树枝——stick 既是"树枝"又是"黏住"，字面回答
facts.anchor: What’s brown and sticky? A stick.

facts.fact: 蓝色、毛茸茸的？蓝色绒毛——同义反复（tautology）式答案
facts.anchor: What’s blue and fluffy? Blue fluff.

facts.fact: 蓝色、不太重？浅蓝色——light 既是"浅"又是"轻"
facts.anchor: What’s blue and not very heavy? Light blue.

facts.fact: 绿色、闻起来像红油漆？绿油漆——把"闻起来像"的类比直接取消
facts.anchor: What’s green and smells like red paint? Green paint.

facts.fact: 男孩放学兴奋告诉妈妈：老师提问只有他知道答案
facts.anchor: A boy runs home from school and excitedly tells his mum, ‘Mummy! Mummy! Today at school the teacher asked a question and I was the only one who knew the answer!’

facts.fact: 原来老师的问题是"谁放屁了"——孩子的"知道答案"其实是不打自招
facts.anchor: ‘Who farted?’

facts.fact: 我莫名其妙卷进一场关于"无主呕吐物"的谈话——不知道是谁"提出来的"（brought it up 又指呕吐）
facts.anchor: I’ve somehow got into a conversation about ownerless vomit. I don’t know who brought it up.

facts.fact: 有人觉得吃鼻孔里掏出来的东西没问题，但那"不是（acceptable）"——it’s snot 谐音 it's not
facts.anchor: Some people think eating stuff you find up your nose is acceptable, but it’s snot.

facts.fact: 怎么让纸巾跳舞？往里放点 boogie（布吉舞曲），boogie 又指鼻屎（booger）
facts.anchor: How do you make a tissue dance? Put a little boogie in it.

facts.fact: 便秘的数学家怎么解决？他用铅笔"算出来"——work out 既是解算也是排出
facts.anchor: How did the constipated mathematician solve his problem? He worked it out with a pencil.

facts.fact: 兔子和李子的区别？两者都是紫色的，除了兔子——答案声称兔子是紫的
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between a rabbit and a plum? They’re both purple except for the rabbit.

facts.fact: 白色、穿格子裤的是谁？冰箱鲁珀特——纯粹荒诞的命名
facts.anchor: What’s white and wears tartan trousers? Rupert the Fridge.

facts.fact: 路人见围栏里传出"七十三！"的齐声呼喊
facts.anchor: A man is walking down the road and sees an area with a wooden fence completely surrounding it, and chants coming from inside of, ‘Seventy-three! Seventy-three! Seventy-three!’

facts.fact: 他凑到洞眼张望，一根手指立刻戳中他的眼睛，呼喊变成"七十四！"——计数的是被戳眼的人
facts.anchor: A finger immediately pokes him in the eye, and the chant changes to, ‘Seventy-four! Seventy-four! Seventy-four!’

facts.fact: 要找一群身高都超过六英尺四的修士——"a tall order"（难办的事）字面是"高的订单"
facts.anchor: I’ve been asked to find a group of monks that are all over six foot four. That’s a tall order.

facts.fact: 苍蝇撞挡风玻璃时最后一个"穿过它脑子"的东西？它的屁股
facts.anchor: What’s the last thing to go through a fly’s mind when it hits a windscreen? Its bum.

facts.fact: 一英尺长、滑的东西？拖鞋——slipper 含 slip，字面"滑的东西"
facts.anchor: What’s a foot long and slippery? A slipper.

facts.fact: 海滩为什么笑？因为海草——sea weed 谐音 he/she/we 谐音 see weed
facts.anchor: Why did the beach laugh? Because the sea weed.

facts.fact: 字母汤喝多了会制造一次巨大的"元音运动"——vowel movement 谐音 bowel movement（排便）
facts.anchor: If you eat too much alphabet soup you end up making a huge vowel movement.

facts.fact: 不会魔法的魔术师叫什么？Ian——名字里藏着"I ain't"（我不是）
facts.anchor: What do you call a magician who isn’t magic? Ian.

facts.fact: 医生说“水星在你的天王星里”——Mercury 是水星，Uranus 又指肛门；病人说不懂占星，医生答“我也不懂，我的体温计刚碎了”
facts.anchor: Mercury is in Uranus.

facts.fact: 在电梯里放屁"在这么多层面都不对"——levels 又指楼层
facts.anchor: Farting in a lift is wrong on so many levels.

facts.fact: 有人自问自答你不烦吗？我烦——说话者自己就是自问自答
facts.anchor: Don’t you hate it when someone answers their own questions? I do.

facts.fact: 碗里放多少豆子？239，再多就太"放屁"了——farty 谐音 forty
facts.anchor: How many beans should you put in a bowl? 239. One more would be too farty.

facts.fact: 腹泻是遗传的——"在基因里跑"（runs）又是"拉肚子"
facts.anchor: Diarrhoea is genetic. It runs in your genes.

facts.fact: 面包师手为什么臭？他"揉"了一坨屎——kneaded 谐音 needed
facts.anchor: Why did the baker have smelly hands? He kneaded a poo.

facts.fact: 穿袜子睡觉的人叫什么？Tiny——toes in（脚趾在里面）谐音
facts.anchor: What do you call someone who sleeps in their socks? Tiny.

facts.fact: 咖啡为什么像泥？因为它是磨碎的（ground 又指地面）
facts.anchor: Why does coffee taste like mud? Because it’s ground.

facts.fact: 高尔夫球手为什么穿两条内裤？以防"一杆进洞"（hole in one 又指裤子破洞）
facts.anchor: Why did the golfer wear two pairs of underpants? In case he got a hole in one.

facts.fact: 电话亭里的河马叫什么？卡住了（stuck）——不回答名字而回答状态
facts.anchor: What do you call a hippopotamus in a phone box? Stuck.

facts.fact: 苹果树上有多少苹果？全部——问题看似问数量，答案把范围设为全部
facts.anchor: How many apples grow on apple trees? All of them.

facts.fact: 组合式办公设备与我的屁股的区别？一个有 files and parts——files 既是档案也是锉刀，parts 既是零件也是私处
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between a piece of self-assembly office equipment and my bottom? One has files and parts …

facts.fact: 我拉了一坨进了吉尼斯世界纪录——后悔把书摊开在浴室里（"拉进书里"的字面义）
facts.anchor: I did a poo that got into the Guinness Book of World Records. I regret leaving the book open in the bathroom.

facts.fact: 云每天穿什么？Thunderpants 谐音 underpants
facts.anchor: What do clouds wear every day? Thunderpants.

facts.fact: 抱婴儿上公交，司机说这是他见过最丑的婴儿
facts.anchor: A woman gets on a bus with her baby. The bus driver says, ‘Whoa, that’s the ugliest baby that I’ve ever seen! Gross!’

facts.fact: 邻座男子劝她去找司机理论，并说"我帮你看着猴子"——把婴儿降格成猴
facts.anchor: The man says, ‘Go up there and tell him off. It’s alright, I’ll look after your monkey.’

facts.fact: 男子在炸鱼薯条店要"牛排腰子派"，把 kidney 说成 kidley
facts.anchor: A man walks into a chip shop and says, ‘Can I have a steak and kidley pie please?’

facts.fact: 店员纠正，他说"我说的就是这个，diddle I"——把 didn't I 说成 diddle I（diddle 又有"欺骗/乱搞"义）
facts.anchor: ‘Don’t you mean a steak and kidney pie?’ says the woman behind the counter. ‘I said that, diddle I?’
